entities.summary: Roeland Pieter Schaftenaar is a Dutch professional basketball player for ZZ Leiden of the BNXT League. He is also a member of the Netherlands national basketball team. Standing at 2.11 m, he plays as power forward. His brother Olaf Schaftenaar also plays professional basketball.
